import json, socket, sys
from pathlib import Path
label, pid = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2])
ready = json.loads((Path('/tmp/parity-home') / ('ready-' + label + '.json')).read_text())
assert ready['pid'] == pid and ready['address'] == '127.0.0.1' and 1 <= ready['port'] <= 65535
cmds=[b'pwd', b"cd '/fixture' && cd 'space dir' && pwd", b"cd '/fixture/space dir' && ls -la"]
def read_exact(s, n):
 b=b''
 while len(b)<n:
  part=s.recv(n-len(b))
  if not part: raise RuntimeError('short response')
  b+=part
 return b
def exchange(cmd, extra=b'', short=False):
 with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',ready['port']),timeout=3) as s:
  declared=9 if short else len(cmd)
  s.sendall(b'BASHSSH1\ncmd-len %d\nstdin-len 0\n\n' % declared + cmd + extra)
  if short:
   s.shutdown(socket.SHUT_WR)
   assert s.recv(1)==b''
   return b''
  head=b''
  while not head.endswith(b'\n\n'):
   head+=read_exact(s,1)
   if len(head)>512: raise RuntimeError('response header limit')
  lines=head[:-2].split(b'\n'); assert len(lines)==4 and lines[0]==b'BASHSSH1-RESP'
  fields=dict(line.split(b' ',1) for line in lines[1:])
  assert fields[b'rc']==b'0' and fields[b'stderr-len']==b'0'
  return read_exact(s,int(fields[b'stdout-len']))
if label=='valid':
 assert exchange(cmds[0])==b'/fixture\n'
 assert exchange(cmds[1])==b'/fixture/space dir\n'
 assert exchange(cmds[2])==b'selected-needle\n'
elif label=='extra': assert exchange(cmds[0],b'extra')==b'/fixture\n'
elif label=='short': exchange(b'pwd',short=True)
else: raise ValueError('bad control')
print('control='+label+' complete')

import json, sys
try:
 rows=[json.loads(x) for x in open(sys.argv[1])]

cases.setup_script:
export PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
P=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/farm600-sftp-remaining-reviewed-peer.py
/usr/bin/python3 -I "$P" guard setup
SRC=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/transfer-sftp-ssh-r3.py
A=/tmp/parity-case/fixture-sftp-adapter
/usr/bin/install -m 0755 "$SRC" "$A"
/usr/bin/sha256sum "$A" > "$HOME/adapter-control.txt"
/usr/bin/stat -c 'mode=%a uid=%u' "$A" >> "$HOME/adapter-control.txt"
read -r digest name < "$HOME/adapter-control.txt"
[[ $digest == 18b2920ad89a6f9a85bb595147ad9ea087c794d9b1956673783770c3d540df3b && -x "$A" ]] && /usr/bin/cmp -s "$SRC" "$A" || exit 98
[[ -x /usr/lib/openssh/sftp-server ]] || exit 98
printf '%s\n' '{"phase":"case","deny":false}' > "$HOME/sftp-config.json"
printf 'cd "space dir"\nls\nbye\n' > "$HOME/nav-control.batch"
/usr/bin/sftp -b "$HOME/nav-control.batch" -S "$A" fixture > "$HOME/nav-control.out" 2> "$HOME/nav-control.err"
[[ $(/usr/bin/python3 -I "$P" listing control) == 'listing=1' ]] || exit 98
/bin/cp "$HOME/sftp-invocations.jsonl" "$HOME/nav-control-invocations.jsonl"
: > "$HOME/sftp-invocations.jsonl"
for label in valid extra short; do
  count=1; [[ $label == valid ]] && count=3
  /usr/bin/python3 -I "$P" peer "$label" "$count" > "$HOME/peer-$label.stdout" 2> "$HOME/peer-$label.stderr" & child=$!
  printf '%s\n' "$child" > "$HOME/control-$label.pid"
  trap 'if [[ -n $child ]]; then kill "$child" 2>/dev/null || :; wait "$child" 2>/dev/null || :; fi' EXIT
  for ((i=0;i<200;i++)); do [[ -s "$HOME/ready-$label.json" ]] && break; kill -0 "$child" 2>/dev/null || break; /usr/bin/sleep .05; done
  [[ -s "$HOME/ready-$label.json" ]] && kill -0 "$child" 2>/dev/null || exit 98
  /usr/bin/python3 "$PWD/native-control.py" "$label" "$child" > "$HOME/control-$label.out" 2> "$HOME/control-$label.err"
  if ! wait "$child"; then child=; exit 98; fi
  child=; trap - EXIT
done
/usr/bin/python3 -I "$P" controls
